note: Curated business hypotheses. The UI separates selling products, cultivation and services. Supplier/buyer links open search pages and are not verified stock, actual buyers or sales forecasts. Tourism fit is a planning hypothesis. It receives local ranking influence only when an explicitly mapped attraction lies within 3 km; it is not evidence of visitor numbers or demand.
